flags.caption:
Meet our August Member of the Month, Milu! 🎉

Milu joined the SWEAT440 family in March 2026, shortly after becoming a first-time mom. Like many new moms, she struggled with taking time for herself, but she quickly discovered that investing in her own health made her feel stronger, happier, and more present for her family.

Since day one, Milu has shown incredible dedication and consistency. In just a short time, she gained more than strength—she found confidence, energy, and a supportive community that has cheered her on every step of the way.

Her commitment and positive attitude inspire everyone around her, and we’re so grateful to have her as part of the SWEAT440 family. 💪

Fun Fact: When she’s not at the studio, you’ll probably find her enjoying mate, cumbia, asado, and fernet! 🧉💃

Congratulations, Milu! Thank you for showing up, working hard, and inspiring our community every day. We can’t wait to see what you’ll accomplish next! ✨

#SWEAT440 #SWEAT440Midtown #NeverLate #MemberOfTheMonth #FitnessCommunity
flags.why: Caption: the studio-authored "Fun Fact" line names fernet, an alcoholic spirit, alongside mate, cumbia and asado; the emojis used are mate and dancing, not alcohol. Visual analysis: cover image is the member standing in the studio in a 100 Club crop top and leggings in front of the official milestone shields — no alcohol visible anywhere in frame. Neither strict Category 4 trigger is met (no on-camera consumption, no happy-hour framing), so this sits below the stated bar and is surfaced only because brand copy names a spirit.
flags.action: Quick glance to confirm or dismiss — recommend dismiss, since visual review confirms no alcohol on camera and the reference is an incidental cultural detail. If SWEAT440 wants a stricter line, advise Midtown to keep named alcoholic beverages out of studio-authored member profiles going forward.
